_comment: GENERATED PIN — the astro-mine-platform commit the vendored Core schemas were copied from, and their exact bytes. Checked by `pnpm check:core-schema` (CI, networked, CORE_REPO_TOKEN). `frames/generated/units.ts` is generated FROM these bytes by `pnpm codegen:units`; never hand-edit either. REPOINTED IN ui#6: this pinned astro-mine-core@v0.3.0, a repository superseded by the four-distribution split and pending retirement (docs#93) — a guard watching a file nobody will update again is not a guard. The paths inside are unchanged, because the platform consolidated the packages under one src/astro_mine/, and the bytes are unchanged, which is how the repoint was verified. The platform publishes no tags, so this pins a commit SHA. To re-sync: copy the files from the platform at the new commit, update this pin, re-run `pnpm codegen:units`. See conventions.md §3.1 (cross-language and vendored consumers).
